name: Ohime-sama☆Ecchi ~H no Tehodoki! Oshikake Futago ni Omakase~
original_name: お姫様☆エッチ～Hの手ほどき！押しかけ双子におまかせ～
source:
Kazunori is an ordinary student. One day, twin sisters Sera and Seri suddenly come to his house. They are princesses he met when he was a kid. "We've been waiting for you for more than ten years!" Yielding to their love approach, he finally sleeps with them....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
和则只是一名平凡的学生。某天，一对双胞胎姐妹塞拉与塞莉突然找上门来——原来她们竟是和则幼年时结识的异国公主！“我们已经苦苦等了你十多年啦！”面对双胞胎公主热情似火的求爱攻势，招架不住的和则终究拜倒在温柔乡中，与姐妹俩共度春宵……

[摘自ErogeShop]
